title: Count concluded
description: A counting session ended and these are its totals. Emitted once per session, not per detection: a count only means something once the thing being counted has stopped arriving. A session is bounded by its source — a recording ends at EOF, a live stream ends after an idle period with nothing crossing. Deliberately unit-agnostic (packs, pallets, cartons, vehicles) so any counting module can emit it; `unit` names what was counted.

net.description: Signed net movement over the session: total_in - total_out. Negative means net outbound.

total_in.description: Units counted moving inbound (into the truck / past the gate).

total_out.description: Units counted moving outbound. Non-zero usually means a correction or a mis-load being removed.

crossings.description: Discrete crossing events behind the totals. Lower than total_in when units arrive in groups (one pallet crossing can carry 30 packs).

needs_review.description: Crossings the counter flagged as low-confidence. A high ratio against `crossings` means the net should not be trusted unreviewed.

session_started_at.description: When counting began. The envelope's occurred_at is the emit instant — always the END of the session — so the start is carried here.

complete.description: False when the session was cut short (operator stop, stream lost) and the totals are partial.

source_kind.description: Whether the session ran against a live stream or a recorded file.

breakdown.description: Per-class detail (in/out/net by detected class). Detail only — nested objects are stored and displayed but cannot be filtered on in a flow, so every number worth automating on is a top-level scalar above.
